items.description: S1 E8 | Meet everyone from the Greek Chorus to Jackie the Drag Queen without “Her” Wig. Rob and the cast confront each other with old feuds fuming. Cynthia returns! Will there be funding for Little House on the Ferry?

items.title: Little House On The Ferry: Act I
items.description: S1 E9 | A love triangle begins between Randall who is turning thirty and wants to marry his boyfriend Timothy but meets Jake the Blogger at Happy Hour. Antonio is pining for Max the Muscle Queen and Donnie is lamenting the death of his partner George with the passing of the gay marriage equality act.

items.title: Little House On The Ferry: Act II
items.description: S1 E10 | Randall must decide between love at first sight and his boyfriend of four years while he searches for his dream. Donnie seeks love on an app while Antonio comes to a new reality when searching for muscles.

items.title: Alex Newell
items.description: S1 E1 | Josh sits down with Alex Newell, star of Broadway’s Once on This Island to discuss the unique career path of this gender-fluid vocal prodigy. From his beginnings on Glee, to his insistence on having casting directors see him outside the perimeters of gender, Alex explains to Josh why “all pronouns are welcome.”

items.title: Javier Muñoz
items.description: S1 E2 | Javier Muñoz--star of Hamilton and In The Heights--explains his winding path to landing the most important musical role on Broadway in the last 25 years, Alexander Hamilton. Despite financial pressures that forced him to quit the business and a HIV diagnosis that almost killed him, Javier tells Josh how he did it, and why he keeps fighting for the little guys.

items.title: Isabelle McCalla
items.description: S1 E3 | Isabelle McCalla, the star of Aladdin and The Prom, is no shrinking flower. “Izzy” sits down with Josh to tell him about her meteoric rise on Broadway and the ground-breaking lesbian kiss on a Macy’s Parade float that threatened her life…but finally gave her the courage to come out.

items.title: Bradley Gibson
items.description: S1 E4 | Bradley Gibson, Broadway’s Simba, takes a long look at the trending hashtag #Broadwayisracist. From his humble beginnings as a gay, Black man in rural North Carolina to his debut in The Lion King, Bradley explains why he’s hopeful for the future of Black roles on Broadway.

items.title: Adrienne Walker
items.description: S1 E5 | As a trained opera singer, Adrienne Walker never saw herself on Broadway. But after starring in Porgy and Bess in Chicago, she decided to give it a go in New York where she quickly landed the role of Nadia in the Lion King. Embracing her irregular journey to the Great White Way, Adrienne started the influential podcast “32 Bar Cut” to become a hopeful voice for the young Black actors of her generation.

items.title: Jason Gotay
items.description: S1 E6 | Jason Gotay’s steamy stint on HBO’s Gossip Girl found him fast fame, but Jason’s roots are in musical theatre. From his first role in Mean Girls, Jason shares the ups and downs of his career, including the big role he worked hard for years to land…and didn’t.

items.title: Psycho
items.description: The music video for "Psycho" by Sunel Molina.

items.title: Human Nature
items.description: The music video for "Human Nature" by Sunel Molina.

items.title: Breathe On Me
items.description: The music video for "Breathe On Me" by Sunel Molina.

items.title: Poco Vengativo
items.description: The music video for "Poco Vengativo" by Sunel Molina.

items.title: Driveslow
items.description: "driveslow" was originally written for "The High Note" and inspired by Post Malone "Sunflower" and Tom Petty "Free Falling." When they turned the song down, I decided to keep it for myself.

items.title: Fallinlove
items.description: "fallinlove" was written in the home of Rodney Jerkins while pitching songs for The Weeknd. When the song was turned down I decided to keep it for myself.

items.title: Dusk
items.description: The R&B/Pop record was Produced by Sean Hamilton (H.E.R "Hard Place", Jac Ross "Saved") and is an ode to lost love inspired by classic hip-hop and 60’s boy bands. The pair recorded the record in the home of Rodney Jerkins while working with him on the TV Series “Empire”. The accompanied video dropped on 3/15/21 and was directed by Juss Thrasher and Milo Demartile.

items.title: R.I.P
items.description: The record was produced by BlvkM0nd4y and recorded in the home of Rodney Jerkins during the summer of 2017. While BlvkM0nd4y pulled inspiration from Eric B. & Rakim’s “Mahogany”, YawnyBlew channels the ambient vocals of James Blake and Frank Ocean on this tale of loss and longing. The song was initially intended for The Weeknd and was later shortlisted for Songland before Yawny decided to keep it for himself.

items.title: Hollywood Hooker
items.description: Bailey's provocative and visually stunning new video for "Hollywood Hooker" is no different, described as a "rock opera fantasy." The eye-catching video, which boasts dazzling costumes, sensual choreography, and a color palette of vibrant and muted deep reds and ocean blues, was made in collaboration with diverse queer arts collective Slather Studios at Savage Ranch — an intentional creative community in the Southern California desert.

items.title: Shenis
items.description: Now, Bailey is back with her latest trans empowerment anthem "Shenis" and a sexual-liberation themed music video. Shot on site at the Savage Ranch — an oasis where creatives can feel safe to express and create under the California sky — Bailey and her crew of queer trendsetters create visual magic through lighting, sensual movement, sumptuous costume, and suggestion. The video's sweeping aerial shots and chic desert vibes lend well to the song's sleek, hot-to-the-touch feel.

items.title: Hornatia
items.description: Having created a burlesque-inspired, jazzy house tune that, not only, sexually liberates the curious soul but encourages a positive message of safe sex, sexual empowerment and the reclaiming of our rights over our own bodies, Love Bailey, Wowashwow, and Goddess Obiani are releasing their first powerful, femininely-divine single, “Hornatia.” Gloriously “horny,” it drips in saxophone riffs and oozes with sultry vocals.

items.title: He Belongs To The City
items.description: In this colorful visual, Victor bounces back from a canceled date by inviting his friends out for a night on the town. Throughout the evening he goes from disappointment to dancing when an unexpected surprise leaves a smile on his face. The music video showcases 20 Black-owned brands and businesses plus a special cameo by the incredible Miss LaLaRi.

items.title: Idle Hands
items.description: The music video for "Idle Hands" by Closegood.

items.title: Sativa
items.description: S1 E1 | Teddy and James light up and reminisce over old dreams. James grows fearful that his dreams present a grim premonition for his romantic future.

items.title: Um, What?
items.description: S1 E2 | During a night out, Teddy and James try to escape an unfortunate chance encounter with old acquaintances.

items.title: Keep The Sex Toys
items.description: S1 E3 | Teddy and James take edibles while house-sitting, and are faced with a door-to-door sales rep selling spiritual toys.

items.title: Like, DIED, Like?
items.description: S1 E4 | After his date learns of his mother's death mid-hookup, James and Teddy meet and gossip about bad one night stands.

items.title: Home Early
items.description: S1 E5 | While waiting for Teddy, James runs into an old flame. When the two go to hookup, they have an awkward run-in with Teddy and her date.

items.title: The Wrong Ass Mr. Right
items.description: S1 E1 | Sharrod finds his pandemic world flipped upside down after a morning of passionate infidelity. Joey throws Sharrod a surprise party creating the perfect storm for trouble. Lauren lowkey catches the undercover vibes in the room. Sharrod is forced to face his accomplice, his secret, and tell his friends how things started with old fling Asher.

items.title: Ready For A Situationship
items.description: S1 E2 | Joey and Cameron share with the group a flashback to the wild shenanigans of how they first met. The boys reunite for an overdue kiki giggle about the highs and lows of Pandemic love. Cameron and Joey grow closer as Asher makes a decision that would change things with Sharrod for good.

items.title: We All Just Wanna Be Loved
items.description: S1 E3 | Sharrod gets a surprise visitor at his birthday party that reminds him when one thing ends, another begins. Cameron begins to really see Sharrod for the very first time. Lauren begins to take action on her growing suspicion somehow opening Joey’s eyes. The group turns up the heat playing old school party games.

items.title: Own It, All Of It
items.description: S1 E4 | Sharrod is forced to play one last game that reveals a secret undeniable connection. Joey hints to Cameron he’s on to him, Lauren confronts Sharrod forcing him to flashback to how it all went down. Joey discovers a familiar item that leads him to his breaking point after Sharrod confesses to his selfish doings.

items.title: We Just Can’t Win, Can We
items.description: S1 E5 | After a heartbreaking confession of his selfish ways, Sharrod finds himself alone and left to pick up the pieces of his life. Cameron appears in the midst of the aftermath and wages war with Sharrod, searching for a middle ground over what’s real vs what’s right between them.

items.title: Schoolies
items.description: S1 E1 | When an outbreak of syphilis hits a cohort of schoolies, Langdon and Steph are tasked by their new, hard-nosed boss, Miranda Graft, to diagnose as many at-risk teens as possible. However, when the competition becomes personal the pair begin prioritising quantity of-patients over quality-of-treatment and soon risk the future of their clinic.

items.title: Friends
items.description: S1 E2 | When a patient comes in for a cervical screening test, the socially evasive Steph does everything she can to ensure the procedure goes as quickly as possible, but soon her escalating attempts to cut the visit short bring disastrous results. Meanwhile, Langdon attempts to evade a Loan Shark who is pursuing him for his student debt.

items.title: Oldies
items.description: S1 E3 | When an outbreak of crabs rocks a local retirement village, Langdon and Steph head out to investigate, but before they can successfully treat the randy octogenarians Steph must get over her childhood fear of the elderly and Langdon must learn to stop treating old people like children.

items.title: Celebrity
items.description: S1 E4 | When a local radio DJ who Steph admires comes in for a checkup, Steph tries to do whatever she can to act normal, and ensure her hero doesn't think she's weird.

items.title: Bikies
items.description: S1 E5 | When Steph becomes irritated by her perpetually upbeat colleague, she decides to get even with Langdon by sending him on a mission to check the prostate of a dangerous bikie gang leader, pushing Langdon's can-do nature to the limit.

items.title: Daddy
items.description: S1 E6 | When Langdon's father shows up for a testes check, Steph brings a group of medical students in to observe the procedure in order to teach her colleague a much-needed lesson in patient privacy, but soon finds that she may have pushed Langdon too far.

items.title: Pride
items.description: S1 E7 | When a video of Steph accidentally burning a rainbow flag goes viral, Steph is branded as a homophobe, despite being part of the LGBTI community herself. Langdon attempts to help her remedy the situation by putting on a pride celebration rally at the clinic.

items.title: Boys
items.description: S1 E8 | When Graft finally makes good on her threat to close down Metro Sexual, Langdon decides to put on a musical to save the clinic with his new theatre actor boyfriend Tim, but Steph is dubious of Tim and suspects his motives might not be entirely pure.

items.title: Medical Students
items.description: S2 E1 | When the release of a new dating app results in an explosion of STIs across Victoria, Steph and Langdon decide to hire a medical student. But when two medical students show up by mistake, Steph and Langdon must choose which to keep: the studious Yasmin or the entitled Herman. Langdon, feeling threatened by the bright and competent Yasmin, begins a campaign to champion the arrogant Herman in the hope Yasmin doesn’t get to stick around.

items.title: The Pollie
items.description: S2 E2 | When a bigoted politician visits the clinic, Steph and Yasmin are conflicted about the ethics of treating someone so morally dubious. But when the details of the politician’s visit are spread online, Steph must work out who the source of the leak was in a bid to keep her job. Meanwhile, Langdon helps Greg woo receptionist Gwen in an attempt to stop him from catching so many STIs.

items.title: Martha Bradbury
items.description: S2 E3 | After a graphic billboard promoting the clinic gets vandalized, Langdon sets out to bring the graffiti artist to justice. Meanwhile, Steph loses her grip on sanity when a new patient appears to be disturbingly similar to her eccentric childhood imaginary friend - an imaginary friend with a dark secret…

items.title: Foreign Correspondence
items.description: S2 E4 | Metro Sexual brings in a translator to assist a patient who cannot speak English, but when Langdon falls head over heels for the handsome translator he starts coming up with dubious reasons the patient needs to return so he can continue seeing the translator. Meanwhile, Steph fears the worst when Amelia Krabb from the health department requests a meeting, but the situation takes a turn for the worse when she learns that Krabb wants to get Langdon fired.

items.title: The Fappies
items.description: S2 E5 | When Steph and Langdon are both nominated for Sexual Health Doctor of the Year, their competitiveness goes into overdrive as they compete to come out on top. But things between Steph and Langdon sour as Steph believes Langdon has cheated. Meanwhile, Gwen agrees to babysit her baby cousin in an attempt to score a job interview at a daycare, hoping to realise her dream job of working with kids.

items.title: The Tribunal
items.description: S2 E6 | Langdon’s tribunal arrives to determine whether he’ll keep his medical license. Realizing what a mistake she made getting Langdon fired, Steph takes up Langdon’s defense to prove he’s an ethical doctor. Meanwhile, Yasmin eyes up a career post-placement and Greg gathers the courage to tell Gwen how he feels.

items.title: Breakdown
items.description: A song about ambition, fear, and striving for more but fearing the worst.

items.title: Fashion
items.description: S1 E1 | Edina Monsoon and her best friend Patsy face a heavy day. Eddy is frantically preparing for her debut fashion show and trying to prove to her daughter, Saffron, that she can function without booze. Patsy, content for alcohol to remain a substitute for food, isn't helping.

items.title: Fat
items.description: S1 E2 | Eddy is contemplating ways to lose weight. The problem becomes critical when she hears she is going to be visited by her reed-like model friend from the 60s. Drastic measures are taken as Eddy embarks on an aggressive weight loss regime which includes 'sleep running'.

items.title: France
items.description: S1 E3 | When Eddy and Patsy take a trip to Provence, they find the language barrier is the least of their problems. Tension between them mounts as they drive round in circles looking for their accommodation, trying to remember which side of the road the French drive on.

items.title: Iso Tank
items.description: S1 E4 | Banned from attending Saffron's college open day, Edina sulks in the brand new isolation tank she's had shipped over from LA. As she slips into a dream-like state, her world begins to change, but not necessarily for the better.

items.title: Magazine
items.description: S1 E5 | Patsy decides to go to work for the first time ever, sending shock waves through her magazine company. To drum up publicity she organises a fashion show, but it's put in jeopardy when at the last minute all of her models quit. Will she be able to persuade Saffron to help her out?

items.title: Hospital
items.description: S2 E1 | Patsy finds herself in the middle of a tabloid scandal when her affair with a politician is exposed. But having her moral rectitude questioned is nothing compared to the indignity of having her true age revealed in the press. Meanwhile, Eddy stubs her toe and insists on immediate surgery.

items.title: Death
items.description: S2 E2 | After receiving news of her father's death, Edina takes the theme of transience to heart and decides to invest in some immortal works of art. Patsy is called in to help her find the right acquisitions, but Saffy is disgusted that her mother is more upset about putting on weight than the death of her own father.

items.title: Morocco
items.description: S2 E3 | Patsy, Eddy and Saffron head to Marrakech for a photo-shoot. Edina and Patsy use the trip as an excuse to shop for ethnic fashions, while Saffron turns her attention to the native inhabitants. However, it's not long before tensions between Eddy's best friend and daughter come to a head.

items.title: Poor
items.description: S2 E5 | Eddy's ex-husbands have discovered that she has been deceiving both of them into paying her alimony, and cut off all support. Eddy is forced to cut her expenses, but Saffron despairs when her mother's attempts at frugal living take her food shopping in Harrods, and getting rid of the driver proves to be a false economy.

items.title: Birth
items.description: S2 E6 | When Eddy and Patsy decide to have a night out, Saffy looks forward to the chance of a quiet night in with her boyfriend. But when Gran absent-mindedly locks them all in the sitting room, Eddy attempts to have a serious chat about the facts of life - with the aid of Cosmo magazine's sex quiz.

items.title: Door Handle
items.description: S3 E1 | Eddy's determination to make sure the decor in the new kitchen is perfectly co-ordinated takes her to New York in search of the perfect door handle. Saffy is not impressed, and to make matters worse Patsy wants her help interpreting a letter from the health authority.

items.title: Happy New Year
items.description: S3 E2 | Saffy has plans for New Year's Eve - a quiet night in with Gran, her dad Justin and his boyfriend Oliver. But this won't do for Eddy, who has made a resolution to have more fun and plans to see in the New Year at a club in an underground car park. All plans are halted, however, by the arrival of Patsy's long lost sister Jackie.

items.title: Sex
items.description: S3 E3 | Eddy has become frustrated with the size of her bedroom and wants to expand it by knocking down the wall to Serge's room. While rummaging through his stuff she finds an adult magazine and realises that it's been a very long time since she had sex - so Patsy comes up with a plan.

items.title: Jealous
items.description: S3 E4 | PR-land quakes with anticipation as the award season approaches. Edina, having paid for them, naturally expects to win her fair share. Meanwhile, Saffy gets some extra special education from her psychology lecturer. Naomi Campbell puts in an appearance as herself, but where is Lulu when you need her?

items.title: Fear
items.description: S3 E5 | Patsy shacks up with Edina after Saffy leaves for university, but the pair find it hard to survive alone. Everything gets significantly worse for Eddy when Lulu decides to join a more efficient American PR company, and when Patsy also gets some bad news they are faced with a major crossroads in their lives.

items.title: The End
items.description: S3 E6 | Eddy and Patsy decide to go their separate ways. Patsy flies to New York to try her hand as a magazine editor, while a lonely Eddy joins a commune in search of her real self and Gran is left at home to become addicted to the shopping channel. It's not long before both Eddy and Patsy realise that life just isn't the same without the other.

items.title: Parralox
items.description: S4 E1 | Patsy has had a Parralox injection to freeze her wrinkles. Saffy is trying to get a job with New Labour and Edina, who now runs a television company as well as her PR enterprise, has got herself an appearance booked on This Morning with Richard and Judy. As her TV appearance draws near, Edina succumbs to the power of Parralox.

items.title: Fish Farm
items.description: S4 E2 | When Saffy employs the tousle-haired Jago to redesign the garden, Patsy recognises him as the younger brother of a well-known aristocrat and Eddy decides to turn on the charm.

items.title: Paris
items.description: S4 E3 | Patsy and Edina go on a photo shoot to Paris for a 'generation flex' feature in which old and young mingle. Patsy teams up with a supermodel, while Edina teams up with Saffy. But Patsy finds the shoot is not quite the glamorous trip down memory lane she expected.

items.title: Donkey
items.description: S4 E4 | Edina embarks on a detox diet in a desperate attempt to get thin. But her nights are plagued with visits from God and the devil, who have their own agendas. Saffy gets picked up by a pretentious old school friend and Patsy decides to try life without a fringe.

items.title: Small Opening
items.description: S4 E5 | Saffy's play opens at a small fringe theatre. Afraid that the play could bring her public humiliation, Edina and Bubble plot to get it cancelled. Meanwhile, Saffy's father Justin, Edina's first husband Marshall and his American girlfriend Bo arrive to offer moral support.

items.title: Menopause
items.description: S4 E6 | Edina's company is haemorrhaging clients to PR rival Claudia Bing. The only client left on her books is Twiggy. Patsy seems to be going through the menopause so Saffy arranges for Patsy and Edina to attend a meeting of Menopause Anonymous. They may never be the same again.

items.title: Gay
items.description: S4 E7 | Patsy is now chief buyer for a new designer shop called Jeremy's. She goes to New York Fashion Week to find ideas but her plans are subverted by Edina's search for Serge, Saffy's long departed older brother and their encounter with social counsellor Goldie. Meanwhile Bo and Marshall are running a Christian TV show and Saffy has been observing the world from inside a cupboard to help her career as a writer.

items.title: Cleanin'
items.description: S5 E1 | Saffy has been away in Iraq as an aid worker and Eddy has had no-one to curb her extravagance. Her clients have also deserted her in droves. But she continues to take little interest in her remaining client - Emma Bunton. When Saffy finally arrives home she has some shocking news in store for Eddy.

items.title: Book Clubbin'
items.description: S5 E2 | Saffy receives a visit from her sadistic midwife and is subjected to a demonstration of the most painful aspects of childbirth. Eddy meets with her book club and is distressed to find that Elizabeth Hurley has pulled out. Only Patsy, Plum and Mariella Frostrup turn up to discuss the merits of OK! magazine.

items.title: Panickin'
items.description: S5 E3 | Eddy has installed a state of the art 'panic room'. It contains CCTV monitors, board games and, of course, alcohol. Meanwhile, Patsy has an eventful day at Jeremy's and meets Minnie Driver. Patsy persuades her to visit Eddy's for a personal styling session, but things don't quite go to plan.

items.title: Huntin' Shootin' Fishin'
items.description: S5 E4 | Eddy has splashed out on a weekend of country pursuits with Patsy. They are disappointed to find that hunting and killing small animals is off the menu. Meanwhile, Saffy is at home hanging out with her girlfriends - Emma and Sarah. But Sarah starts to display an unhealthy interest in Emma's fame.

items.title: Birthin'
items.description: S5 E5 | It's a big night for Patsy. She's about to host the Style Awards at the Royal Albert Hall. Patsy has acquired some exclusive Huki Muki gear for the occasion. Saffy having reached blimp-size is about to go into labour and opts for a home birth. But her waters break at an unfortunate moment.

items.title: Schmoozin'
items.description: S5 E6 | Eddy has rekindled her relationship with childhood sweetheart Pete. He's an engineer at Abbey Road studios and has found some lost Beatles recordings. In order to trumpet the discovery Eddy wants to throw a listening party. Elton John is of course invited.

items.title: Exploitin'
items.description: S5 E7 | Baby Jane's bawling is driving Eddy nuts. Saffy isn't finding much joy in her new motherhood either. But help is at hand - in the unexpected form of Patsy. Unbeknownst to Saffy, Patsy has found Jane a modelling assignment. Now if Saffy can just be persuaded to leave the house with John.

items.title: Cold Turkey
items.description: S5 E8 | Patsy hates Christmas and refuses to acknowledge its existence. Unfortunately Eddy has plans this year and for the very first time, she wants to stay at home with Saffy and her grand daughter. All of this Christmas spirit is too much for Patsy and she finds herself in a downward spiral.

items.title: White Box
items.description: S5 E9 | Eddy wants to redecorate the kitchen. Naturally, she calls on her interior designer friends, Bettina and Max, for advice on the new look. She is sure she has seen what she wants somewhere - perhaps it was in a past life. Meanwhile, Mother is looking after the baby amid all the chaos, Saffy is doing her best to get Patsy to move out.

items.title: Meeting People Is Easy
items.description: S1 E1 | Stuart, king of the gay club scene in Manchester, is on the prowl when he picks up the young and pretty Nathan. It’s just another pull for Stuart, but Nathan’s hooked.

items.title: Unfinished Business
items.description: S1 E2 | Having not yet come out to his coworkers, Vince faces the uncomfortable task of going on a date with new employee Rosalie. Stuart tries to pry off a clingy Nathan.

items.title: It Happened One Night
items.description: S1 E3 | Donna, fed up with hearing about Stuart, takes Nathan out to find a new boyfriend. Vince runs into the wrong person at a gay pub, and Phil takes things too far with a new friend.

items.title: Death and Remembrance
items.description: S1 E4 | It’s Phil’s funeral, and Stuart and Vince hear where his distraught mother places the blame. Vince meets Phil’s accountant Cameron, and they hit it off. Nathan’s betrayed and takes off.

items.title: Constant Craving
items.description: S1 E5 | Hazel and Janice are worried about Nathan, who’s been staying out with a new boy. Stuart’s sister asks him to babysit her two sons, but he’s never been good with kids.

items.title: Married ... With Children
items.description: S1 E6 | Despite not having come out to his parents, Stuart visits them with his sister to discuss their divorce. He also agrees to talk to Nathan about his acting out, but things quickly go sour.

items.title: That's What Friends Are For
items.description: S1 E7 | Stuart organizes a surprise birthday party for Vince, but can’t help spicing it up with a little drama, inviting Rosalie and agreeing to sabotage Romey’s marriage.

items.title: Crimes of the Heart
items.description: S1 E8 | Vince thinks Rosalie is going to out him at work, Stuart gets his first taste of rejection and Nathan does something drastic.

items.title: Out of the Closet, Into the Fire
items.description: S2 E1 | Nathan’s back from London, Vince has broken up with Cameron and Stuart’s hand is forced when his nephew finds out he’s gay and blackmails him.

items.title: End of the Road
items.description: S2 E2 | Stuart retaliates when Alexander is forced out of his father’s will and overdoses. Vince vies for a promotion at work, and Nathan get no help with the bullies at school.

items.title: Full Stop
items.description: S1 E1 | NOAH and ELIZA are trying to have a baby. But Noah won’t be the father. He and his husband DAN will be the baby’s uncles. Because Eliza’s planning on raising the baby with her wife MARGOT, who happens to be Noah’s sister. But Eliza is having second thoughts after Margot’s most recent manic episode, and Dan wants Noah to drop out of his PhD program so they can start a family of their own. Can this unconventional family stay together, or will their lives and relationships fall apart?

items.title: Raspberry
items.description: S1 E2 | Eliza is two months pregnant and still hasn’t told Margot, who is building an art installation in the middle of the desert, and Noah and Dan’s one night stand with ADAM has turned into a regular thing. At the urging of their mother CAROLYN, Noah invites Margot over to check on her, and they confess that they are both on the verge of a breakdown.

items.title: Lemon
items.description: S1 E3 | The gang goes on a psychedelic mushroom trip at ARTHUR’s Desert Disco Oasis, and tensions erupt when Margot decides to go off her meds. Noah and Dan’s situationship with Adam turns romantic, and Dan and Eliza bond over their shared realization that they’re not cool anymore.

items.title: Apple
items.description: S1 E4 | The sudden death of Noah and Margot’s estranged father WAYNE brings the gang back to Texas, where Margot starts experiencing grief-induced psychosis and Noah discovers their mother Carolyn has been hiding a troubling secret.

items.title: Pomegranate
items.description: S1 E5 | Noah spends Thanksgiving helping his mother Carolyn clean out her hoarder house, while Eliza throws a tense dinner party with Margot and Dan to get content for her business’ Instagram.

items.title: Eggplant
items.description: S1 E6 | After Carolyn moves in with them, Noah and Dan try to hide their relationship with Adam, Dan’s parents come over on Christmas and pressure them to fast-track the adoption process and Margot reveals she’s gone off her meds.

items.title: Whiskey Bottle
items.description: S1 E7 | After a month off her meds, Margot experiences a manic episode, Eliza discovers that there may be a complication with her pregnancy, and Noah and Dan discover Adam has been harboring a secret that may jeopardize the adoption process.

items.title: Honeydew
items.description: S1 E8 | With their lives and relationships falling apart, everyone is faced with making difficult choices about the future.

items.title: A Fucking Baby
items.description: S1 E9 | With Eliza’s due date approaching, Margot checks out of the mental health facility unsure whether she has a home to return to and Noah and Dan must come to a decision about their separation.

items.title: Nick & Steve
items.description: S1 E1 | In the season premiere, we match Nick and Steve! Will they find love at first date, or is this relationship down for the count?

items.title: Myles & Kevin
items.description: S1 E2 | This episode, we match lovely lads Myles and Kevin! Can a day at the beach with a hunky surf instructor change their minds about love? Let's find out!

items.title: Mikey & Dearl
items.description: S1 E3 | In this episode, we join Mikey and Dearl for an incredible master class on what NOT to say on a first date!

items.title: Jeremy & Michael
items.description: S1 E4 | In this episode, we meet two cool California boys who happen to both live in the Big Apple - Jeremy and Michael. Will the revelation that Michael's a vegan be a deal breaker for Jeremy?

items.title: Mike D. & Mike P.
items.description: S1 E5 | In this episode, we get to know the two Mikes, a pair of gorgeous city boys with similar careers. Will tantric yoga help bring them together, or make things too close for comfort?

items.title: Jordan & Joe
items.description: S1 E6 | In this episode, we're getting metaphysical with Jordan and Joe, two cuties who find themselves tangled up in blue within moments of meeting! But will Joe's off-beat opinions match up with Jordan's take on the world? Let's find out!

items.title: Gil & Manny
items.description: S1 E7 | What would you do if you walked in on your first date, and found him in nothing but his underwear? Then you look down and you're also in your undies. That's the situation facing our studly daters Gil and Manny in this season's finale!

items.title: Main Character Energy
items.description: S1E1 | What does it really mean to have "main character energy"? In this episode of I'm Dead, comedians Percy Rustomji, Sarah Rose Hyland, and Salina EsTitties explore the messy, hilarious, and deeply relatable quest for confidence. Through stand-up performances and personal reflections, they tackle family expectations, insecurities, identity, and the often ridiculous situations that come with navigating everyday life.

items.title: Poly, Pan, and Poor Decisions
items.description: S1E2 | From polyamory and pansexuality to dating disasters and romantic detours, Adario Mercadante, Seth Robichaux, and Keira McGill share hilarious stories about navigating love, attraction, and the messy choices that make relationships anything but simple.

items.title: Excuse My Beauty (Ignore My Anxiety)
items.description: S1E3 | In Excuse My Beauty (Ignore My Anxiety), Lady Bushra, Marval A. Rex, and Deven Bouchet take on identity, self-image, and the pressure of being perceived. Whether reflecting on growing up in Bradford, decoding internet-fueled self-improvement trends, or sharing the realities of life in your 40s, the comedians uncover the humor, anxiety, and humanity behind how we move through the world.

items.title: CTRL+ALT+DELUSION
items.description: S1E4 | Technology may make life easier, but these comedians know it also makes it weirder. Yammo the Yeen shares hilarious insights into furry culture and growing up queer in the South, Ashley Ryan finds comedy in airport security and social media algorithms, and Kaycee Conlee tackles gentle parenting, online shopping, and parents on Instagram. Three distinct voices deliver smart, fearless takes on surviving the absurdities of modern life.

items.title: My So-Called Queer Life
items.description: S1E5 | Percy Rustomji, Pressure K, and Lady Bushra share hilarious stand-up inspired by the unpredictable world of queer love and relationships. From disastrous first romances and sexual discovery to religion, marriage, heartbreak, and dating mishaps, each comedian offers a unique perspective on the search for connection. Through fearless storytelling and razor-sharp observations, My So-Called Queer Life celebrates the chaos, vulnerability, and comedy of modern romance.

items.title: Don't Like Me? Blame My Parents.
items.description: S1E6 | Marval Rex, Sarah Rose Hyland, and Percy Rustomji share hilarious stand-up inspired by their experiences growing up queer. From coming out and navigating family expectations to religion, culture, and identity, each comedian offers a unique perspective on finding their place in the world. Through fearless storytelling and sharp observations, they transform deeply personal moments into unforgettable comedy that celebrates resilience, authenticity, and connection.

items.title: Twerk Life Balance
items.description: S1E7 | In "Twerk Life Balance," Seth Robichaux, Deven Bouchet, and Salina EsTitties explore the dreams, day jobs, and unexpected detours that shape a career. From chasing show-business ambitions and working with special-needs students to turning a Spice Girls obsession into a life in drag, the comedians reveal the hard work—and harder laughs—behind becoming exactly who you are.

items.title: Big Feelings, Bigger Mouths
items.description: S1E8 | Big feelings. Bigger mouths. Zero apologies. Salina EsTitties, Marval A. Rex, and Sarah Rose Hyland go all in on dating in drag, deep-sea anatomy, getting older, and everything the body does when nobody asked it to. Loud, filthy, and unapologetically queer, these comics are redefining what it means to live and laugh out loud.

items.title: See Something, Gay Something
items.description: S1E9 | In See Something, Gay Something, Seth Robichaux, Keira McGill, and Kaycee Conlee clock the absurdity hiding in plain sight, from Southern masculinity and MAGA logic to gender confusion, social-media breakups, and strangers asking lesbians exactly how they plan to make a baby. Sharp, shameless, and gloriously queer, these comics see the nonsense, say the thing, and leave no sacred cow un-roasted.

items.title: Dildos, Duststorms, and Dinner
items.description: S1E10 | In Dildos, Duststorms, and Dinner, Deven Bouchet, Ashley Ryan, and Kaycee Conlee prove that queer social life is a full-contact sport. Friendship, dating, community, and nightlife collide as every outing threatens to become a hookup, a protest, a breakup, or an unforgettable bad decision. Loud, loose, and gloriously unfiltered, this episode celebrates the people who make life messier, funnier, and worth leaving the house for.

items.title: Fur, Sequins, and a Five O'clock Shadow
items.description: S1E11 | Lady Bushra, Pressure K, and Adario Mercadante look back on the places they came from, the rules they inherited, and the lives they built anyway. Immigration, family expectations, therapy, first freedoms, and growing up queer all get the rewind treatment in an episode full of hard-won wisdom and second chances. Think big feelings, bad advice, and the stubborn belief that your best years might still be ahead of you.

items.title: Some Assembly Required
items.description: S1E12 | Keira McGill, Ashley Ryan, and Pressure K are done following directions. Self-help gets weird, gender rules get tossed, and standing up for yourself can apparently involve crystals, family drama, a jail cell, or a very personal beef with Santa Claus. Through anxiety, identity, and the expectations they were handed growing up, they find plenty to laugh about while putting themselves together on their own terms. Turns out becoming who you are takes confidence, persistence, and a little creative assembly.

items.title: Aligning Your Chakras with Salina EsTitties
items.description: S1E1 | This week on Mic Drop, Damian is joined by beloved LA native and international drag superstar, Salina EsTitties! From her rise in the Los Angeles drag scene to taking her talents to a global audience, Salina shares stories, laughs, and insights from her journey, making for a candid and entertaining conversation you won't want to miss.

items.title: 2 Pound Sarah with Sarah Rose Hyland
items.description: S1E2 | This week on Mic Drop, Damian is joined by hilarious comedian and artist, Sarah Rose Hyland! She opens up about her experiences attending an all-girls Catholic school, the shocking lie she kept up for seven years, her ultimate guilty-pleasure TV show, and, of course, the inspiration behind her incredible character, Kentucky Lightning. Don’t miss this laugh-out-loud conversation as these two dive into unforgettable stories with plenty of laughs.

items.title: Butt Plug Scare with Percy Rustomji
items.description: S1E3 | This week on Mic Drop, Damian sits down with longtime friend, colleague, and all-around hilarious comedian, Percy Rustomji! The two take a trip down memory lane, reflecting on their journey through the industry and the road that led them to executive producing the Revry comedy series I'm Dead. From Whoopi Goldberg's shocking government name to an unforgettable car-towing mishap, this episode is packed with laughs you won't want to miss.

items.title: Wonky Miniatures with Keira McGill
items.description: S1E4 | This week on Mic Drop, Damian sits down with New York native and comedian Keira McGill. From a lifelong fascination with miniatures to navigating being misgendered as a child, Keira shares candid stories about her journey, what’s next in her career, and plenty more along the way.

items.title: Doing It All with Seth Robichaux
items.description: S1E5 | This week on Mic Drop, Damian sits down with Las Vegas comedian Seth Robichaux! Seth shares the stories behind his spot-on impressions, his ambitions as a multihyphenate performer, and the unbelievable experience of being accused of stealing Debbie Reynolds' Academy Award. Tune in for an episode you won't want to miss!

items.title: Behind the Fur with Adario Mercandante
items.description: S1E6 | This week on Mic Drop, Damian is joined by comedi-yeen and proud furry Yammo the Yeen, aka Adario Mercadante! Adario opens up about his unique journey at the intersection of comedy and the furry community, from the hilarious story of getting his first fur suit to what that milestone meant to him. He also unpacks what it really means to be a furry, the joy the community brings, and what newcomers should know if they're furry-curious. And just when you think you've heard it all, Adario delivers a Mic Drop moment that will leave you speechless. It's a conversation full of heart, humor, and a whole lot of fur.

items.title: From High Top to Mic Drop with Deven Bouchet
items.description: S1E7 | This week on Mic Drop, Damian is joined by the incredible Deven Bouchet! Deven dishes on their obsession with All the Queen’s Men, survives an Angela Bassett pop quiz, and reveals how Sherri Shepherd helped launch their comedy career. Plus, they share their experience on Revry’s "I’m Dead" and deliver a jaw-dropping Mic Drop moment that will leave you inspired. You have to hear this one!

items.title: Middle Aged Karens with Lady Bushra
items.description: S1E8 | This week on Mic Drop, Damian is joined by the hilarious Lady Bushra. They discuss everything from becoming the "Karen Slayer" and her love for Joan Rivers to moving to Los Angeles and filming her debut comedy special, I'm Dead. She also gives us the scoop on her upcoming work, and gives Damian a quick lesson on drive-bys. With an unforgettable Mic Drop moment that will have you questioning your Prius, you won't want to miss it!

items.title: The Transsexual Jason Bateman with Marval Rex
items.description: S1E9 | This week on Mic Drop, Damian sits down with incredible actor and comedian, Marval Rex! He dishes on his latest acting projects, his days as a granola hippie in Humboldt County, and the odd job that helped him afford top surgery. Plus, catch his hilarious take on "catching print" from his special on Revry's own Mic Drop. It's an honest, funny, and unforgettable conversation you won't want to miss.

items.title: Topless Protesting with Ashley Ryan
items.description: S1E10 | Damian is joined this week by the fabulous and funny New York comedian, Ashley Ryan! Ashley shares stories from her time working for Joan Rivers on Fashion Police, talks about the stunning Swarovski look created for her on Project Runway, and reflects on organizing an epic protest in support of trans rights outside of Trump Tower. Tune in for a hilarious, insightful and inspiring conversation you don't want to miss.

items.title: Comedy, Therapy, and the ATL with Pressure K
items.description: S1E11 | Damian is joined by Atlanta-based Drag King and comedian, Pressure K! They discuss the intersection of stand up comedy and mental health and what it was like to appear on two iconic Revry Original series!

items.title: Gender, Culture and Libra Charm with Vico Ortiz
items.description: S1E12 | Damian is joined this week by incredible performer, Vico Ortiz! Vico talks about celebrating Puerto Rican culture through a queer lens, their journey as a polyamerous person, and healing ancestral wounds.

items.title: The Journey of an Artist with Henlo Bullfrog
items.description: S1E13 | This week, Damian sits down with fellow King's Court member, Henlo Bullfrog! They talk about Henlo's journey being diagnosed and treated for CRPS as a teenager, their costume design skills being Tony-nominated, and the story behind their unique name.

items.title: F to Milhouse with Perka Sexxx
items.description: S1E14 | Damian talks this week with Mr. Congeniality from King of Drag Season 1, Perka Sexxx! They dive into Perka’s journey to becoming a proficient web developer, what inspired them to take the leap into drag, and Perka drops the mic on the importance of proper lash glue. Tune in!

items.title: Dream Job with Cameron Esposito
items.description: S1E15 | This week, Damian is joined by comedian, producer, and host of King of Drag Season 2, Cameron Esposito! They talk Cameron's latest addition to the family, the importance of supporting our own comminuty, and what it was like to play such an integral role in Revry's very own King of Drag.

items.title: A Backwards Hat and a Dream with VERA!
items.description: S1E16 | Damian is joined this week by King of Drag's very own, VERA! From fathering 45 children in their family (not including the grandkids!) to continuing their national tour alongside fellow drag performer Pattie Gonia, VERA! gets candid about career, family dynamics, and so much more.

items.title: Love Thyself with Papi Culo
items.description: S1E17 | This week Damian welcomes King of Drag Season 2 contestant, Papi Culo! Papi opens up about everything from their PCOS journey and how it has shaped their drag, all the healing practices they've learned along the way, and... a packer full of crystals? Don't miss this heartfelt conversation that will leave you inspired.

items.title: Gay Fieri with Chase Lounge
items.description: S1E18 | Damian sits down this week with longtime friend and King of Drag contestant, Chase Lounge! Chase dishes on the story behind their iconic name, their passion for producing live shows, and the community they've found through Drag Kingery. From the yassification of Guy Fieri to their Real Housewives takes, this is one interview you won't want to miss.

items.title: Drag is Medicine with Twinka Masala
items.description: S1E19 | Joining Damian this week is King of Drag season 2 finalist, Twinka Masala! They talk the importance of living visibly queer, building a strong support system, and why season 2 was just the right timing for them. This conversation will leave you motivated and inspired. Tune in!

items.title: Love, Identity and Activism with Dustin Lance Black
items.description: S1E20 | Damian is joined by Academy Award-winning director, writer, and activist Dustin Lance Black. They discuss the intersection of activism and filmmaking, family, and the power of experiences bigger than ourselves, along with the deeply personal exploration of identity at the heart of the new film Rock Out(2025).

items.title: Gender Bending with Gottmik
items.description: S1E21 | This week, Damian sits down with trailblazing drag queen and regular judge on King of Drag, Gottmik! They talk about the iconic piece that came from Gaga's closet, the hilarious way he got on the cover of Vogue, and how he came to fall in love with Drag Kingery. Tune in for a hilarious and heartfelt conversation.

items.title: Gag It! with Lollygag
items.description: S1E22 | Damian sits down with week with King of Drag Season 2 finalist, Lollygag! He opens up about how his love of Buster Keaton both inspires and challenges him as a performer, his experience of being diagnosed with autism as an adult, and shares the touching story of how his loved ones encouraged him to start doing drag.

items.title: Freaks Welcome Here with D. Vour
items.description: S1E23 | Damian sits down with week with King of Drag Season 2 finalist, D. Vour! They talk favorite moments and looks from the competition, who inspires their drag, and what it was like to be a finalist. Plus, a hilarious story involving an unconventional packer you won't want to miss. Tune in!

items.title: Sexy, Silly and Stupid with Trade
items.description: S1E24 | Damian is joined this week by King of Drag Season 2 finalist, Trade! He dishes on the most shocking moments from filming and the surreal experience of meeting someone who has long inspired him: Laith Ashley. Trade also opens up about the incredible people in his life who encouraged him to audition, how he’s evolved as a performer over the years, and so much more. Plus, don't miss his moving and essential PSA on how to treat nightlife performers with the respect they deserve!

items.title: Battle of the Boy Bands
items.description: S1 E1 | Get ready for the kings to pop, lock, and drop it as they tackle the iconic world of boy bands! First, they'll strike a pose in the sports trading card-themed Weenie Challenge before hitting the main stage for the Beefy Challenge with their best boy band performances. Special guest judges Revry CEO, Damian Pelliccione and the Director of Bridesmaids, Paul Feig, will be here to decide who has the right stuff!

items.title: The Dong Show
items.description: S1 E2 | The kings show off their improv skills in a group Weenie Challenge before transforming into legendary celebrities for “The Dong Show”:  King of Drag’s celebrity impersonation talent show! Comedy pros Jeff Hiller and Bridget Everett join Murray Hill for a Somebody, Somewhere reunion and are guest judges on the Kings’ Court for this unforgettable episode.

items.title: Death of Your Fears
items.description: S1 E3 | The kings face their phobias head-on, starting with a scarifying “Make-Up in the Dark” Weenie Challenge. Then, in a deeply personal Beefy Challenge, they'll confront their greatest fears through the transformative power of drag. With special guest judges Liv Hewson (Showtime’s Yellowjackets), Vico Ortiz (HBO Max’s Our Flag Means Death), and Landon Cider (winner of Dragula).

items.title: Prom Night
items.description: S1 E4 | Relive the awkward glory of prom! First, for the Weenie Challenge, the kings test their knowledge in a Drag King History Quiz. Then, it's time for an “Under the Seaquins”-themed Beefy Challenge as they create dazzling aquatic-themed looks and campaign for the role of Prom King. Special guest judges Carmen Carrera, Brian Michael Smith, and Jackie Beat will crown the royalty of the night.

items.title: A Song for the King
items.description: S1 E5 | Let's rock! The kings unleash their inner rock stars in a high-energy Weenie Challenge before battling it out in an epic Lip Sync Battle. Get ready for fierce competition and killer performances with special guest judges Kathleen Hanna (Le Tigre), comedian Cameron Esposito, and Aubrey Shea (Revry’s Unconventional).

items.title: Showbiz
items.description: S1 E6 | The crown is within reach! In the grand finale, the remaining kings pull out all the stops in a final showdown to determine who will be named the FIRST EVER “King of Drag”. Featuring guest judges on the Kings’ Court: Tony-winning playwright and actor Cole Escola (Oh, Mary!), legendary actress and “Real Housewife” Lisa Rinna (Prime Video’s Traitors), Damian Pelliccione (Revry CEO), and Kylie Sonique Love (MTV’s RuPaul’s Drag Race).

items.title: Hollywood!
items.description: S2 E1 | Lights, camera, action! Eight new Kings arrive in Hollywood ready to battle for the crown as Cameron Esposito takes the reins as the new host of King of Drag, presented by e.l.f. Cosmetics.  For their first Beefy Challenge, the Kings pair up to create their own original movie concepts, complete with blockbuster posters and live, trailer-worthy performances. Academy Award-winning screenwriter and director Dustin Lance Black joins the Kings’ Court as special guest judge — and a surprise twist starts the season off on a wild ride!

items.title: Horror
items.description: S2 E2 | Things get freaky when the Kings enter a haunted carnival for a night of horror! First, they create fabulous and fearsome facial hair — without using any actual hair — in the “Bearded, Bedazzled and Beheaded” Weenie Challenge. Then, for “Assigned Freak at Birth,” the kings reclaim what makes them different by creating sinister circus characters and terrifying theatrical performances. RuPaul’s Drag Race winner Yvie Oddly joins the Kings’ Court for a frightfully fierce night of competition.

items.title: Comedy
items.description: S2 E3 | Bring on the funny! The Kings kick off Comedy Week with “Clown Car Countdown,” racing against the clock to create Glamour Clown makeup while riding through the streets of Los Angeles. Then, they transform into famous faces and reveal some unexpected talents in The Dong Show, King of Drag’s outrageous celebrity impersonation talent show. Comedian Dana Goldberg and Season One favorite Big D join the Kings’ Court for a night of big laughs and unforgettable performances!

items.title: Country
items.description: S2 E4 | Saddle up, Kings — it’s Country Week! With no Weenie Challenge in sight, the remaining Kings go straight for the beef as they split into two country bands to write and record original songs that put a Drag King spin on the hyper-masculine world of country music. Then, they hit the Royal Hall to perform their new country hits with full choreography. Singer-songwriter Frankie Simone and RuPaul’s Drag Race All Stars winner Ginger Minj join the Kings’ Court for one rootin’, tootin’ showdown.

items.title: Fantasy & Fairytales
items.description: S2 E5 | Once upon a time, five Kings entered a magical kingdom with the finale within reach! First, the Kings become “Fairy Godfathers,” using their makeup skills to transform members of the Trans Latina Coalition into gorgeous princes. Then, for the “Suit Yourself” Beefy Challenge, they transform ordinary suits into elevated, avant-garde fantasy ensembles fit for a royal ball. Actor, model, and advocate Laith Ashley joins the Kings’ Court for a magical night where the stakes have never been higher.

items.title: Clip Show
items.description: S2 E6 | Think you’ve seen everything? Think again! Cameron Esposito takes us behind the scenes of Season Two with never-before-seen auditions, hilarious outtakes, backstage antics, and unforgettable moments that didn’t make it into the competition episodes. From the Kings finding out they made the cast to the comedic chaos behind the crown, it’s an all-access celebration of everything that made this season of King of Drag unforgettable.

items.title: Reunion
items.description: S2 E7 | The Kings are back together! Cameron Esposito and Damian Pelliccione reunite the Season Two Kings to revisit the competition, reveal behind-the-scenes stories, and catch up on everything that’s happened since filming wrapped. The Kings dish on their friendships and brotherhood, favorite moments, and the things viewers never got to see. It’s one last royal gathering before the crown is finally awarded!

items.title: Finale
items.description: S2 E8 | The crown is finally within reach! The final Kings pull out all the stops with showstopping performances designed to prove they have what it takes to wear the crown. But only two can advance to the ultimate showdown, where they go head-to-head in an epic lip sync battle. With the full Kings’ Court assembled and the eliminated Kings returning to cheer on their brothers, one performer will make history as the second-ever King of Drag!

items.description: S1 E1 | Academy Award winner Dustin Lance Black opens his revealing series with the hidden history of Brian Epstein, the closeted manager who discovered the Beatles at the Cavern Club and built them into the biggest band in the world.

items.title: The Duchess, the Queen, and the Countess
items.description: S1 E2 | Brian Epstein takes the Beatles to America, conquering Ed Sullivan and the country's biggest stages, all while guarding a private world of confidants, lovers, and coded identities back home.

items.title: The Disruptors
items.description: S1 E3 | The 1970s bring a new wave of disruption, as David Bowie, glam pioneer Jobriath, and New York's CBGB punk scene push rock's queer outsiders into the mainstream.

items.title: Punk Rock Boy
items.description: S1 E4 | As Elton John's story unfolds, Lance's own story comes into focus: he learns the truth about his late brother's favorite punk rock musician—a secret his brother never got to know, closing out the series' hidden history with its most personal moment.

items.title: Toxic Boyfriends of Greek Mythology: Part the First
items.description: S1 E1 | Buckle up for one of the most infamous - and lesser-known - gay couples in Greek mythology: Zeus and Ganymede, originators of the divine Daddy-Twink dichotomy. We'll discover what these myths tell us about ancient Greek homosexuality IRL, and how they provided much-needed PR for the complex reality between mortal sheets.

items.title: Le Chevalier d'Éon: From Russia With Mess... in a Dress
items.description: S1 E2 | The unbelievably wild and weird life story of the Chevalier d'Éon: transgender spy, soldier, and sleuth of the Enlightenment. Assigned male at birth, Charles eventually transitioned to become Charlotte, before discovering the humiliating constraints of life as an 18th century woman.

items.title: William Shakespeare vs. Christopher Marlowe: Who's Gayer?
items.description: S1 E3 | William Shakespeare and Christopher Marlowe: brilliant dramatists and...bisexuals? We unpack the rumors, the hearsay and the straight-up gay poems that suggest these titans of English literature were also really, really, ridiculously (good-looking) gay.

items.title: V on V: The Very Sapphic Story of Virginia Woolf and Vita Sackville-West
items.description: S1 E4 | A review of the life and loves of Virginia Woolf. We dive deep into her affair with Vita Sackville-West, leading London lesbian of her day, and relive the parties thrown by the Bloomsbury Set, a group of young Modernists who continued the British tradition of plumbing the nation's bottomless depths of homosexuality. (Or should we say bottom-full?)

items.description: S1 E4 | Eva mourns her breakup and Chandaleer faces financial ruin. Lucy and Eva convince Chandeleer to sugar baby and they invite an escort to Eddie’s apartment for research.

items.title: U.S.S. Vagina
items.description: S1 E5 | As they interview Illana about sex work, Lucy, Chandaleer, and Eva fall in love with the idea of starting their own escort service—much to Eddie’s dismay.

items.title: XXX Marks The Spot
items.description: S1 E6 | The friends launch their new business with Eddie acting as CEO. But when they book their first client, only one of the women has the courage to take the job.
