live.description: Mira películas, espectáculos, música y entretenimiento LGBT en español e inglés.

live.title: Revry
live.description: Watch the best in LGBTQ movies, series, news and music.

providerSeries.title: The Category Is
providerSeries.description: The Revry Original anthology series, The Category Is, explores how ballroom culture has evolved beyond New York City and grown to shape queer communities throughout the world. The series’ first season, The Category Is...Mexico City, introduces the House of Mamis and examines themes of cultural and gender identity, LGBTQ discrimination in Latin America, and self-expression through dance and drag. Get an unfiltered look at what it means to be in the flourishing ballroom scene in Mexico City and get to know this chosen family of queer artists and performers, including house mother, Mendoza; trans-activist, Negraconda; dance enthusiast and dreamer, Ponyboy; and more.

providerSeries.title: Music Out Loud
providerSeries.description: A Revry Original series bringing you the latest and greatest in queer music videos!

providerSeries.title: America In Transition
providerSeries.description: America In Transition, an award-winning, Sundance-backed Revry Original documentary series, explores the community, family, and social issues of trans people of color across the United States - capturing real life for a veteran turned activist, an immigrant seeking home, a woman living with HIV healing from trauma, and a model navigating family life.

providerSeries.title: Drag Roast
providerSeries.description: Cruel, harsh, tasteless...and that’s just the roastmaster! Join the rulers of NYC nightlife as they read their fellow legends to filth in this Revry Original series.

providerSeries.title: Queens of Kings
providerSeries.description: Whether it's the show-stopping inspirational drag of JULIE J, the body bending and thought-provoking performances of GOD COMPLEX, the "object-ionally" hilarious improv stylings of DAVID PUCK, the buzzed about drag king SHOW PONII, the community leader comedy queen CHIQUITITA, or the ear worms of legendary drag reality star HONEY DAVENPORT, this season of QUEENS OF KINGS continues to capture the captivating stories and performances of Brooklyn's most talented performers in and out of drag!

providerSeries.title: Room To Grow
providerSeries.description: This inspiring Revry Original docu-series chronicles the lives of LGBTQ+ youth and their families across North America, offering a raw, intimate glimpse into their daily lives as they endeavor to find their identity and a place in their communities.

providerSeries.title: The Walk-In Closet
providerSeries.description: Roommates Billie, a mediocre-at-best lesbian stand-up comic, and Sterling, a gay ballet dancer with some talent, decide to get married in order to save Sterling's Canadian residency in this Revry Original series.

providerSeries.title: America In Transition: The Digital Series
providerSeries.description: America In Transition brings you intimate trans stories you won’t hear anywhere else. Step into the real-life stories of a veteran-turned-activist, a woman living with HIV healing from trauma, and a model navigating family life in this Revry Original series.

providerSeries.title: Putting On
providerSeries.description: A Revry Original Reality Series, ‘Putting On’ follows a young entrepreneur, On Mekahel, as he struggles to launch his underwear line with his ex-boyfriend.

providerSeries.title: Gayborhood
providerSeries.description: A mock-reality series set in Chicago's LGBTQ neighborhood, seen through the lens of a wacky and outrageous band of friends living in this vibrant neighborhood.

providerSeries.title: Tiny Laughs
providerSeries.description: When a queer Latina architect meets a struggling Asian comic at an improv class, their instant sparks sends them on a humorous and heartwarming journey through the city of dreams.

providerSeries.title: Single Record
providerSeries.description: After reaching his dream of having a hit song, a talented and arrogant rapper learns that his record label will drop him if his next song isn't a hit. His desperation to save his career will force him to confront his identity, sexuality and bring him to new lows that could cost him everything.

providerSeries.title: Faultlines
providerSeries.description: Faultlines, an acoustic folk-pop group known for their three-part harmonies that warm like the California sun and lyrics that speak to the gritty, universal interhuman experience.

providerSeries.title: Persianality
providerSeries.description: In this Revry Original series, hilarity ensues when married couple Bijan and Fereshteh Shoorkhakianian visit Palm Springs. Whether it's sitting by the pool, eating dinner, or getting a couple's massage - there's no denying that this love is lavish.

providerSeries.title: KingQueen
providerSeries.description: KingQueen is a Los Angeles based pop-rock band who recently were added to Music Connection's HOT 100 list placing the spotlight on bands who delivers expert musicianship and intriguing songcraft to stages all over the U.S. The band was formed by lead singer Ina aka Sabrina Petrini and consists of Adam Gimenez, Brandon Valerino, Jake Absher and Ella G. Burgos. KingQueen’s sound is best described as energetic and edgy, delivering sing-along choruses and vulnerable yet self-empowering lyrics.

providerSeries.title: Closet Space
providerSeries.description: High school closet cases Jake and Tara must come out of the closet to embrace their true selves. But that’s only half the problem; once you’re out, there’s a pressure to be all in. For Jake and Tara, the hardest part is figuring out who they want to be.

providerSeries.title: Submission Possible
providerSeries.description: In this Revry Original, Madison Young delves deep into sex magic rituals, herbal aphrodisiacs, cemeteries, sexy seances and spectrophilia in the hauntingly sexy city of New Orleans.

providerSeries.title: Before I Got Famous
providerSeries.description: 21-year-old Alex You moves from China to Hollywood to become an actor in this Revry Original Series.

providerSeries.title: Versus
providerSeries.description: Versus is a charmingly absurdist game show where instincts and fun override smarts and knowledge. It’s a verbal version of “Wipeout” mixed with a gentler “Billy On The Street.”

providerSeries.title: Culture Q
providerSeries.description: Culture Q is a queer-centric news series brought to you by the leading global queer streaming network, Revry. This innovative news series creatively features entertainment, pop culture, lifestyle and political news with wit and insightfully nuanced perspectives. Emphasizing the queer millieu, Culture Q stands to be the leading forum for boundary-pushing discussions and commentary.  Hosted by Percy Rustomji, Culture Q features an ever-changing cavalcade of guests who help capture that X-factor which defines queer culture.

providerSeries.title: Jonathan's Kitchen: Seasons To Taste
providerSeries.description: LGBTQ chef Jonathan Bardzik welcomes family, friends and local foodies into his kitchen to prepare delicious meals with farm-fresh ingredients. Life can, and should, be filled with joy. Jonathan finds that joy each day by preparing a simple meal, setting a table, and sharing it with the people he loves. And now, he wants to share it with you. Join him and a diverse cast of visitors in this 8-episode celebration of farm-fresh, seasonal cooking and the people it brings together.

providerSeries.title: A Horse With A Horn
providerSeries.description: A Horse with a Horn is the solo electro-pop act of Los Angeles' Derek Wanker.

providerSeries.title: Aaron Porter
providerSeries.description: Aaron Porter is one of the UK’s brightest new talents. Aaron’s songs are all based around his life and the things he has learnt to deal with. Moving to London, Aaron discovered a second family of young, gay creatives with whom he grew his own community, dancing for alternative club nights with huge DJs and exploring the burgeoning fashion and music scenes. He released his debut single BOY in late 2018, a celebratory and unapologetic statement of intent.

providerSeries.title: Chelzzz
providerSeries.description: Chelzzz is a rising Hip-Hop artist & Influencer located in South Florida. She is open to doing cross promotional events with businesses to assist one another in branching out to different communities. Chelzzz has performed for some of the industries top agents and has a rapidly growing international fan base. In addition to music, she's established her own entertainment company and merchandise brand 'C3 Official Brand'.

providerSeries.title: Gabby B.
providerSeries.description: Destined for greatness spells out Gabby B’s energy. Carefully molding her genre-defying talent not only stands out in representation of her birthright but all cultures abroad. Her Portuguese, French and English translations gives her an international edge from the GO! Her crafty melody lines from verse to hook creates a wave that puts her ahead of the curve in this 2020 class of entertainers. Either way you receive her, by way of audio or eye candy, it’s gonna be wavy! Gabby is an avid Barbie collector with hundreds of mint condition dolls in her portfolio. She loves the hue of Barbie pink and often models herself after the poise and fashion sense of the doll’s “life sized” persona giving her the nickname, Brazilian Barbie.

providerSeries.title: Jack Rayner X Jonté Moaning
providerSeries.description: Jonte’ Moaning might be a familiar name to you. The singer and dancer was the choreographer on the landmark video for Beyoncé’s song, ‘Freakum Dress’, and not only that, he also choreographed her 2007 world tour. Jack Rayner is no novice to the music industry either, having worked with the likes of Katy Perry, Britney Spears, and Avril Lavigne – just to name a few. Like Jonte’, Jack is also a choreographer, and is no slouch when it comes to stage presentation. Together, the pair have come up with an incredible song and video, with their self-assertion bold as brass and giving a chef’s kiss to all the haters.

providerSeries.title: Malou Beauvoir
providerSeries.description: Haitian-American performing artist Malou Beauvoir, is a captivating, highly emotive singer-songwriter and actor who brings to her artistry the unique amalgamation of her multi-cultural influences and experiences. A citizen of the world, she has lived in the US, Europe and Haiti, and traveled extensively; each culture she has encountered has impacted and informed her in different ways, reinforcing her openness to different perspectives and forms of spirituality.

providerSeries.title: Yaeji
providerSeries.description: An ocean-deep strain of house, hip hop, and subversive pop is making sweaty walls bang from New York to Seoul and beyond. Yaeji (Kathy Yaeji Lee) is a Korean-American DJ and visual artist with a fervent DIY aesthetic and quiet confidence – instead of trying to scrape the wallflowers from the club’s dark corners, Yaeji tends to their vines and blooms. Childhood and adolescence saw her bunny-hopping through NY borough Queens, Atlanta, and Korea, but the artist found her home in Brooklyn’s thriving creative scene. There, she’s well-known for nights that serve Japanese curry to dancers alongside the melodic, soul-hugging dance music. With exhilarating, considered mixes that champion the best of her fresh, PoC, and queer contemporaries, Yaeji has galvanized the dedicated fanbase she deserves with her forward-thinking new wave.

providerSeries.title: Myylo
providerSeries.description: From Nashville, Tennessee, blending together janky classical guitar with a lo-fi sax sensibility, Myylo is a young talent that has people talking.

providerSeries.title: Christopher Sorensen
providerSeries.description: Singer/songwriter Christopher Sorensen's well-crafted music captivates audiences, taking them on an emotional journey.

providerSeries.title: Bear's Den
providerSeries.description: Bear's Den are London trio Andrew Davie, Joey Haynes, and Kevin Jones. The music they make is wholesome, warm, and engaging, and takes its influence from the likes of Being There era Wilco, Ryan Adams, and a wealth of both folk and alt-country reference points.

providerSeries.title: Go Hard
providerSeries.description: Take an exclusive, behind the scenes look at the life of rapper/singer, dancer, songwriter Damez as he takes you to rehearsals, studio sessions, music video shoots, live performances, photoshoots & much more in this docuseries edited and produced by the artist himself.

providerSeries.title: Sally Jessy Rides!
providerSeries.description: Emmy award-winning talk show host Sally Jessy Raphael is back with a series where the questions (and guests) never stop - literally. "Sally Jessy Rides!" features celebrity interviews conducted by Sally on a different form of transportation.  Whether it's a water taxi, scooters in Times Square, a party bus and even a mechanical bull, Sally maneuvers her way through each interview in a style that only she can deliver.  And yes, she'll be rockin' her signature red glasses!

providerSeries.title: The Nest
providerSeries.description: The Nest with Missy Modell brings together some of the most influential women in entertainment and business to delve into hot and often taboo topics affecting women in the modern world.

providerSeries.title: John Chandler
providerSeries.description: John Chandler is an LA-based musician and former boy-bander from Maurice Starr’s 6PIECE. Much of John’s recent struggles, he realizes today, stem from finding success as a teen. “Being discovered by Maurice Starr, the man behind New Kids on the Block and New Edition, in Atlanta, was a blessing and a curse.  On one hand it was amazing, opening for NSYNC on the Pop Odyssey Tour and sharing the stage with acts like Alicia Keys, Jagged Edge, and Trisha Yearwood. On the other, it gave me a false sense of how the world works. I thought dreams were just handed to you at 16, and then you lived happily ever after.”

providerSeries.title: Ryan Cassata
providerSeries.description: Wielding a set of luminous, crisp pipes straight out of the cast of High School Musical, Ryan Cassata crafts immaculate singer-songwriter pop, drawing on emotive pop forms from Blink-182 to Vance Joy to Taylor Swift. With an almost quirky purity, Cassata’s intimate, sing-along ready love stories capture the full-bodied emotional moments in a young person’s life.

providerSeries.title: High Herstory
providerSeries.description: Cannabis consuming ladies tell stories about women in history, which are reenacted using actors and animation.

providerSeries.title: Pot Pie
providerSeries.description: Chef Brandin LaShea must prepare a dinner for her influencer guests with one major hitch: She has no idea what ingredients she'll have until it is time to cook! That is, except for the surprise ingredient she brought, which will either disrupt or elevate the entire experience. Oh, and she is super baked the entire time.

providerSeries.title: Cali Dequan
providerSeries.description: Singer, songwriter, and Texas native, Cali Dequan brings a burning passion and drive to his music, captivating audiences.

providerSeries.title: Cameron McMillan
providerSeries.description: Pop-electronic singer-songwriting vocalist. Born in Louisville KY, but grew up in North Carolina listening to Whitney, Enya, Céline, Michael, Imogen Heap and film scores, Cameron would always transport himself to different worlds while living in a small boring town. “I just want my music to reach people, to touch people, to connect to them, make them feel me. You feel me?” Graduating from East Carolina University with a BFA in Musical Theatre, Cam headed to NYC where he currently resides pursuing a singing career, taking all he’s learned in theatre and music theory and listening/watching the greats and transposing it into his own artistry. Seeking management and/or label representation because he knows more than ever there is a market for queer artists and voices to be heard, celebrated, and spread around the globe. He is currently finishing up writing and recording his new album, a two-part piece, the first titled MASCULINE, in which he composes and records in his studio bedroom.

providerSeries.title: Field Trip
providerSeries.description: Join Jordyn Conway and Tammi Pettigrew (AKA The Cannabis Cutie) on a psychedelic journey through the universe! Part talk show/part Magic School Bus-style adventure, Jordyn and Tammi are joined along the way by celebrities, educators, industry leaders, and even dinosaurs! Smoke up, jump in and get ready for the greatest Field Trip of your life!

providerSeries.title: Angelica Ross
providerSeries.description: From the board room, to film and TV sets to Capitol Hill to the music studio, Angelica Ross is a leading figure of success and strength, in the movement for human rights advocacy focused on Transgender and racial equality. A fan favorite on FX’s award-winning hit POSE plus both the ninth season of Ryan Murphy’s FX hit American Horror Story: 1984 and the double feature tenth season as The Chemist in part 1 and Theta in part 2. Angelica is blazing a trail, kicking open doors, and building her own table with ample open seats.

providerSeries.title: Jakk Fynn
providerSeries.description: Jakk Fynn isn’t going to be boxed in — and if he has anything to do with it, his listeners won’t be, either. The singer-songwriter has given himself the freedom to explore musical soundscapes, melding his roots with his adult endeavors and always embracing the natural state of flux that comes with being an artist in the internet age. Even in his youth, Jakk soaked it all in, whether it was from legacy artists like Nirvana and the Beach Boys or acts more representative of the moment like Backstreet Boys and NSync. Now, after time in bands and years spent in the post-hardcore scene, Jakk Fynn is ready to let himself be exactly who he wants as a musician. As a trans artist in music, Jakk is aware of the need for transmasculine representation in the pop space in particular. As a young adult, there wasn’t an artist like Jakk out there — he’s carving his path not just for himself, but for others like him, proving that it’s all possible.

providerSeries.title: Julian King
providerSeries.description: Julian King, purveyor of heartfelt next-gen R&B, is a Philly native, proud Aquarius, preacher’s kid with virtuoso vocals, dance moves to die for and skillful musicianship on piano. Carrying himself with the poise and class of a seasoned veteran, the youthful and streetwise Julian King has been steeped in music and performance his entire life. Julian’s 2019 debut full-length album, “Made in China”, blazed the scene with its 15 polished tracks including streaming favorites “Seasons”, “Safe” and “Always You”. With repertoire polished during his 2018 year-long tour of the five-star hotels of China, the album remains on repeat-play for scores of lovers of passionate, honest R&B. In December 2020 he dropped his EP, “TAKEOUT” featuring eight tracks including collaborations with Mare, Just Frenchie, Kymberli Joye, Shaun Sounds, Kevin JZ Prodigy, Precious, and Brayla.

providerSeries.title: The CooLots
providerSeries.description: Intersectionality personified, the CooLots are a band hailing from Washington D.C., captivating and moving audiences with their blend of rock and soul.

providerSeries.title: Luka Fisher
providerSeries.description: Luka Fisher is a gender queer trans disciplinary artist, creative producer, and occasional Russian translator. Their work explores gender, identity, memory, process and the artist as producer through their solo work and collaborations with others. As a producer Luka has created gourmet porno themed parafictional hot sauce ("Wyldefire") with chef Royce Burke abs DJ Danny Wylde and produced numerous films and music videos that have screened at a range of festivals from OutFest, The American Documentary Film Festival, In/motion Dance Film Festival, Pornydays and the Museum of Photographic Arts.

providerSeries.title: Submission Possible
providerSeries.description: Submission Possible explores the queer sexual underground worlds of kink, fetish, and BDSM. Written, directed, and created by Madison Young, a feminist icon, author, and sexual revolutionary. The sex and fetish-positive series stars Young as the entrancing guide to an unconventional travel adventure, exploring the kink culture in communities around the world - all through the lens of the queer experience.

providerSeries.title: Cassidy King
providerSeries.description: Over the past few years, singer-songwriter Cassidy King has built a devoted fanbase, thanks to her intensely personal, poignant lyricism and irresistible, pop-forward melodies. In her latest EP, Concrete Walls, King delves even further, delivering a moment of reckoning that only comes with deep self-reflection. In six lushly arranged songs, King examines the intricacies of relationships—with friends, past partners, and, most importantly, with herself.

providerSeries.title: Kyler O'Neal
providerSeries.description: Born and raised the daughter of a minister, Kyler O'Neal began singing as a gospel vocalist, performing at many services and public ceremonies. Kyler would later relocate to Los Angeles, California where she currently pursues artful expressions from singing, writing and acting to dance, theatre and modeling.

providerSeries.title: Punk Adams
providerSeries.description: Punk Adams, a Queens raised Brooklyn native is an Alternative R&B singer and songwriter creating a solid reputation for himself. If you were to mesh together the attitude of rock, the raw emotion of blues, the catchiness of pop, and the soul of R&B, it would give you the distinct, captivating sound that he has crafted.

providerSeries.title: Drag Latina
providerSeries.description: Drag Latina, a Spanish language multinational drag competition hosted by Mexican singer and television actress Ninel Conde with singer Fedro as a mentor and judge. In season one, the Drag Latina queens are Afrika Mendiola, Anika Leclere, Amalara Sofia, Chichi Fuera, Leyla Edwards, Mariah Spanic, Sunel Molina, Valeria Sparx, Venus Carangi, and Vicky Chavarria.

providerSeries.title: Purple Crush
providerSeries.description: Purple Crush is a music and dance collective started by Air Jared and Isla Ebony. With numerous singles and albums dating back to 2003, Purple Crush amassed a following in 2007 after self-releasing their album “Welcome 2 Emo Club” on their Crushed Records imprint. The release solidified this married act as soldiers on the frontlines of a then burgeoning Brooklyn electro movement, becoming favorites in the blogosphere, and riding the blog house wave across the globe to its peak.

providerSeries.title: Queer Youth Animated
providerSeries.description: While lawmakers are busy passing laws and proposing measures to limit the self expression of LGBTQ+ youth in their schools and communities, The Future Perfect Project has been handing the mic over to the next generation of LGBTQ+ youth. Queer Youth Animated is an animated, bite-sized documentary series that portrays the vision of a more perfect future for us all. Edited down from one-on-one interviews with LGBTQ+ Youth, each bite-sized animation gives you a peek into the life of one young person and gives them the opportunity to talk about the topics that matter to them: family, relationships, peer acceptance, clothing, their bodies, social justice, the future, and more.

providerSeries.title: Theality TV
providerSeries.description: Theality TV is a reality show about an Off Broadway Musical given a month and $10,000 to erect a backer’s edition in hopes of getting funding to take the show on the road.

providerSeries.title: Cheat Out
providerSeries.description: Actor and photographer Josh Drake interviews Broadway stars who are eager to share their tales with the hope of educating, encouraging, and inspiring those on the other side of the curtain. From their daily routines to their deepest fears...this diverse group of talented individuals metaphorically lays it all bare before experiencing a makeover and photo session that embodies their personal journeys. Cheat Out uncovers the humans behind the characters and stories we love.

providerSeries.title: Sunel Molina
providerSeries.description: Born in Havana, Sunel Molina grew up in Cuba where he found a passion for music and began to develop his vocal talents. As his pursuits lead him to Puerto Rico and then Dallas, Texas, he continued to cultivate his talents and would go on to incorporate the art form of drag into his craft, auditioning for notable shows such as Tengo Talento Mucho Talento, The Voice, America’s Got Talent, and American Idol. When he is not working on music, Sunel enjoys freelancing as a professional dancer, working out, and spending time with his close friends, family, and dogs.

providerSeries.title: YawnyBlew
providerSeries.description: Born John Gonzalez, Yawny started as a songwriter and journalist in New York City. In 2017 he moved to Los Angeles with the goal of uplifting and aligning himself with more queer voices. Mentored under Rodney Jenkins and Pharrell Williams, Yawny has written songs on upcoming projects from Keiynan Lonsdale, Dyllon Burnside, TikTok Star Marley Bleu, and The Voice Winner Cam Anthony.

providerSeries.title: Love Bailey
providerSeries.description: Love Bailey is a Trans multidisciplinary visionaire focused on bringing queer communities together through an artist-in-residency program called the “Savage Ranch." Having journeyed through several industries from fashion, music, set design and dance, Love has had the pleasure of musing with the likes of Lady Gaga, Naomi Campbell, Britney Spears, Nicki Minaj, Rhianna, and collaborated with brands such as Moma Museum, Warner Brothers, Valentino, Pat Mcgrath, and Vogue magazine just to name a few.

providerSeries.title: Victor Jackson
providerSeries.description: Victor Jackson is sharing Black queer love stories with an R&B groove. His newest EP, "MAN.MUSE.MAGIC." peaked at #20 on the iTunes R&B/Soul chart within hours of its release. Victor has appeared on "The Real Housewives of Atlanta" (BRAVO) and guest-starred on "The Game" (BET), “Step Up: Highwater”(STARZ), and “Lovecraft Country”(HBOMax). As a choreographer and creative director, Victor has worked with Jennifer Hudson, Iggy Azalea, Tamar Braxton, and Kandi Burruss.

providerSeries.title: Closegood
providerSeries.description: Inspired heavily by elements of dark pop, neo-soul, and rap alike, Closegood's transient beats and intricate lyricism deliver feel-good vibes with a bit of bite.

providerSeries.title: InQueeri
providerSeries.description: InQueeri follows two Queer college kids, Teddy and James, on a spiritual journey to make sense of their various identities in a world full of liberal zombies and normative nancies.

providerSeries.title: Neighbors
providerSeries.description: With Broadway shut down and a new virus on the loose, uptown besties Sharrod and Joey rely on each other to stay afloat in this “new normal.”  After things quickly go south for Sharrod and his old fling Asher, he makes a huge mistake the morning of his 31st birthday that could end his friendship with Joey for good. Sharrod fights to keep his secret throughout the surprise birthday party Joey throws for him. Will Sharrod and Joey survive this Pandemic in their friendship?

providerSeries.title: Metro Sexual
providerSeries.description: Sexual health clinicians Stephanie and Langdon have a tough enough job as it is - battling STIs, patients, and arduous colleagues - but when government cuts threaten to close them down they must do whatever it takes to save their clinic.

providerSeries.title: Indigo Dai
providerSeries.description: Indigo Dai is the drag persona of Marlon Meikle -  a Jamaican born, LA-based drag queen, arts educator, host, actor and recording artist. Indigo has been featured on “Call me Kat” on FOX, “The Book of Queer” on MAX, has originated roles Off-Broadway and performed and taught across the globe. Indigo wrote their first single, the defiantly optimistic dance disco bop “Breakdown” and released it, independently, in May 2023.

providerSeries.title: Absolutely Fabulous
providerSeries.description: Jennifer Saunders leads an all-star cast as the outrageous, fashion-obsessed Edina in this multi award-winning comedy. Her life of excess is surpassed only by her best friend Patsy, who smokes like a chimney, drinks like a fish and dresses like a dream. Life would be one long party - if only Edina's swotty daughter Saffy would stop complaining and start joining in like a normal teenager.

providerSeries.title: Queer As Folk
providerSeries.description: The original, ground-breaking and award-winning UK series chronicling the lives of three gay men living in Manchester's gay village around Canal Street.

providerSeries.title: Unconventional
providerSeries.description: UNCONVENTIONAL follows eccentric, queer millennial siblings Noah and Margot Guillory and their significant others Daniel Charles and Eliza Slate, as they try to start an unconventional family while navigating their thirties, trying to stay sane in an unstable world and, most importantly, trying to hold onto the bonds they share.

providerSeries.title: Love Is Blind
providerSeries.description: Is there really such a thing as love at first date? 'Love Is Blind' is going to find out! Each episode introduces two sexy gay singles, both looking for love, then sends them on a zany, unpredictable, and totally blind first date. Best of all, we take you along for the ride. You'll get a peak into their day-long courtship and watch as these men turn each other on—and sometimes turn on each other.

providerSeries.title: I'm Dead
providerSeries.description: I’m Dead is a comedy series combining themed stand-up performances and candid reflections, revealing real-life experiences behind the laughs. Each episode centers on a universal theme, from family and relationships to confidence and identity, as a diverse lineup of comedians offers wildly different perspectives on the same emotional terrain. Through sharp performances, personal storytelling, and unfiltered humor, I'm Dead transforms life's most relatable experiences into bold, honest, and unforgettable comedy.

providerSeries.title: Mic Drop
providerSeries.description: Mic Drop with Damian Pelliccione is a weekly talk show welcoming queer icons where pop culture collides with the stories that matter the most. From bizarre true tales and Hollywood trivia, to unforgettable fashion moments, no topic is off the table. Featuring celebrity guests from shows like I'm Dead, King of Drag, Unconventional, and more, nobody leaves without dropping something real. Tune in for candid, entertaining interviews you won't want to miss.

providerSeries.title: King Of Drag
providerSeries.description: King of Drag, presented by e.l.f. Cosmetics, returns for a bold second season as eight  fierce Drag Kings battle for the crown. Hosted by comedian Cameron Esposito, the  groundbreaking competition puts the Kings through outrageous challenges testing their  comedy, performance, fashion, music, makeup, and creativity. With an illustrious Kings’  Court, special guest judges, and plenty of surprises, Season Two celebrates the artistry,  heart, and limitless possibilities of Drag King culture.

providerSeries.title: Dating Unlocked
providerSeries.description: Dating Unlocked sees daters compete in an ‘anything goes’ elimination-style competition of relationship games to unlock the chance of a second date.

providerSeries.title: Rock Out
providerSeries.description: Academy Award winner Dustin Lance Black traces the closeted managers, artists, and misfits who secretly shaped rock and roll, weaving in his own family's story along the way. Featuring insights from music legends, including Dolly Parton and The Dead Milkmen, and spanning the stories of The Beatles, Little Richard, Ramones, Freddie Mercury, The Who, Bee Gees, and Jobriath.

providerSeries.title: Historical Homos
providerSeries.description: A no-fucks-given guide to LGBTQ+ history, hosted by Donal Brophy and Sebastian Hendra. Welcome to the gayest stories never told.

providerSeries.title: Lip Service
providerSeries.description: Funny, irreverent, and moving, Lip Service is a ground-breaking TV drama series following the interwoven love lives of Frankie, Cat, and Tess, three lesbians living in contemporary Glasgow.

providerSeries.title: Strut
providerSeries.description: In each episode of Strut, we watch Eddie and her friends transform through their risky new endeavor in unexpected positive ways. Eddie is a geeky porn editor whose low self-confidence has turned her into a 26-year-old hermit. Her friends, Eva (an unemployed artist), Lucy (an intern), and Chandaleer (a trainwreck/fashion model) vow to save her from her unhealthy solitude. When the friends decide to start a high-end escorting agency to earn more money, they convince skeptical Eddie to help them build their business and lift her self-esteem. Together they successfully navigate the adrenaline-fueled escorting industry with Eddie as their CEO and fellow sex worker.
